verdict.rationale: Lindy documents agent-run routines triggered on a schedule or event, per-task model choice, and tool use through native integrations, MCP servers, browser driving and code. The evidence does not show a workflow builder where a user inserts discrete AI agent or LLM steps; the whole routine is run by the Lindy agent. Missing for 10: documented discrete LLM/agent steps inside a multi-step workflow, per-step model selection within a workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
Lindy picks the right model for each task so credits go further, and you can choose the model yourself if you'd rather.
Pick your model of choice for each task. Most major models are available.
Point Lindy at a hosted MCP server and it builds actions from the tools that server publishes.
It can drive the browser the way a person would, or write its own integration against the tool's API.
